properties.name: Phase 7, PR 4: a composed check shows where its designs already touch
properties.rationale: Phase 7 PR 4 (epoch:planned-p7-a-hub-on-one-machine, sequence 768), on Anthony's word 2026-10-21 ("Go with recommendations ... start another reflow2 epoch/increment"), from hxm_program's hub feedback of 2026-10-20, item 3: with 14 members nobody hand-declares every seam, so the seam bucket stayed empty where the cross-design bugs are and an empty answer read like agreement. Delivers req:designs-are-shown-where-they-already-touch-before-anyone-declares-it under dec:two-designs-are-linked-on-exact-evidence-and-a-similar-name-is-only-a-candidate, and the link_status rollup fact:defect-whether-a-project-link-is-real-cannot-be-asked asked for (for compositions and pairings; a mirror's surface hash is not read). Reuses PR 2's pin resolution and PR 3's composer; no second of either. Judgement calls: a pin link starts at the pin node (the exact evidence) and ends at the named design's most-connected node, and dec:idea-what-a-pin-threads-in-a-composed-check settled (a) on Anthony's word 2026-10-22, so the hub skill now tells an owner to connect each pin to the component or capability that uses that design; an equal checksum on an empty file or a file every repository carries (LICENSE, README, Cargo.toml, __init__.py ...) is set aside; an absolute path is never evidence; candidates need a name score of 85 and a stated, equal medium, roles not required; pair_designs' link_status speaks for exact evidence alone. Each test is a class invariant (evidence kinds x 2 and N designs x pin states; budgets x shapes) and failed first: the link tests on main e6d4b5a4f (3/3 in_memory, 4 of 5 on_disk), the budget test on PR 4's head c8d6e2e29 (two other designs at 6,000: 6,428 characters). Measured on release builds through the door, PR 3's fixture (hub + 15 exports, 3,196 nodes): compose tracked 4.3-4.5 s before, 4.5-5.3 s after, so links add about 0.2-0.5 s, inside the run-to-run spread; 1,910 -> 1,895 findings; cut-off clusters 118 -> 118 (14 now under hub x member) because the fixture hub's pins are wired to nothing (fact:measured-computed-links-leave-the-fixtures-118-cut-off-clusters-because-the-hubs-pins-are-wired-to-nothing-2026-10-22; wired, 119 -> 101). The default-budget reply was 58,505 characters against 30,000 (45,091 on PR 3: every list at its floor of one whole finding, some naming ~75 ids, and link_status never sampled); bounded now: 29,957 at 30,000, 11,950 at 12,000, 59,983 at 60,000. PR 3's bounded test holds at 6,000, not its original 4,500: what a bound keeps whole there (not_composed for five designs, the counts, the budget block) is 4,697. No node or edge type and no enum changed, so the stamp does not move. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: compose_and_analyse (one other design or several) and pair_designs read where designs touch from their records (touch.rs where_designs_touch): declared cross-design references, and computed links on exact evidence only (the same file by a location in one repository, the repository stated by a pin naming that design, or a URL; an equal checksum outside empty and stock files; a pin naming the other's graph_id or source repository). In a composition each link is drawn (compose.rs draw_links) as a real DEPENDS_ON edge labelled link: computed|declared in the throwaway combined graph before the checks run. Interfaces with closely matching names and one medium are candidates, never edges; bare relative paths and stock checksums are counted in set_aside. link_status files every pair linked, candidates_only, never_touch or not_checked, with a count per status; the composed note carries choice (a)'s cut-off-cluster sentence. The composed reply holds its budget (bound_composed: lists sampled, link_status's included; then each finding's ids cut, keeping affected_ids_total; then whole by_design/by_pair keys withheld; each rung named in withheld_to_fit). The one-other-design reply keeps its keys and adds six link fields; pair_designs adds five. Served text, hub skill (connect each pin to what uses it; read link_status) and the derived edge-readers list updated.
